ieepa_origin_rule_confirmed.label: Selected origin satisfies the emergency Part 102 or last-substantial-transformation rule, with no conflicting covered origin
ieepa_origin_rule_confirmed.description: The emergency note covers either legal origin test. A conflicting origin determination requires reconciliation, not selection of the lower duty.

ieepa_ftz_entry.label: Entry from a foreign trade zone

ieepa_personal_accompanied_baggage.label: For personal use in accompanied baggage of a person arriving in the United States

ieepa_qualifying_humanitarian_donation.label: Donation by a person subject to U.S. jurisdiction to relieve human suffering, without a disqualifying presidential determination
ieepa_qualifying_humanitarian_donation.description: Articles the product of Mexico that are donations, by persons subject to the jurisdiction of the United States, of articles, such as food, clothing, and medicine, intended to be used to relieve human suffering, as provided for in U.S. note 2(b) to this subchapter

ieepa_informational_material.label: Information or informational materials covered by 50 U.S.C. 1702(b)(3)
ieepa_informational_material.description: Articles the product of Mexico that are informational materials, including but not limited to, publications, films, posters, phonograph records, photographs, microfilms, microfiche, tapes, compact disks, CD ROMs, artworks, and news wire feeds

ieepa_usmca_entered_free.label: Entered free of duty under General Note 11, including the specified Chapter 98/99 USMCA treatment

chapter98_provision.label: Chapter 98 provision (eight digits)
chapter98_provision.description: Actual provision claimed, valid in this HTS revision. A declaration alone does not establish eligibility.

chapter98_properly_claimed_and_cbp_agree.label: Entry properly claimed under Chapter 98 and CBP agrees the provision is appropriate

chapter98_repairs_alterations_processing.label: Value of repairs, alterations or processing (USD)

chapter98_us_products_value.label: Cost or value of qualifying U.S. products assembled abroad (USD)

ieepa_chapter98_operations_in_covered_or.label: The Chapter 98 repair, processing or assembly occurred in the emergency action's named origin
ieepa_chapter98_operations_in_covered_or.description: Verify the origin named in the matched source clause. Mixed-country operations need separate reconciliation.

ieepa_canada_cbp_evasion_determination.label: CBP determined the goods were transshipped to evade the specified emergency duties

ieepa_canada_usmca_originating.label: Goods qualify as originating under USMCA (whether or not preference is claimed)

ieepa_potash.label: Article is potash under the applicable emergency action
ieepa_potash.description: Potash that is a product of Mexico, as provided for in U.S. note 2(c) to this subchapter

ieepa_canada_energy_or_critical_mineral.label: Covered Canadian energy product or critical mineral under 30 U.S.C. 1606(a)(3)
ieepa_canada_energy_or_critical_mineral.description: Crude oil, natural gas, lease condensates, natural gas liquids, refined petroleum products, uranium, coal, biofuels, geothermal heat, the kinetic movement of flowing water, and critical minerals, as defined by 30 U.S.C. 1606(a)(3)

s232_auto_approved_us_content.label: Reporting decision represents Commerce-approved U.S. automobile content, not a non-automobile article
s232_auto_approved_us_content.description: Heading 9903.94.02 applies to: (i) all entries of articles classifiable under provisions of the HTSUS enumerated in subdivision (b) of this note, but that are not passenger vehicles (sedans, sport utility vehicles, crossover utility vehicles, minivans, and cargo vans) and light trucks; as well as (ii) the U.S. content of passenger vehicles and light trucks described in subdivision (d) of this note, upon approval from the Secretary of Commerce.

s232_usmca_auto_parts_not_kits.label: Actual passenger-vehicle/light-truck parts eligible for USMCA, excluding knock-down kits and compilations
s232_usmca_auto_parts_not_kits.description: Heading 9903.94.06 applies to all entries of articles classifiable under provisions of the HTSUS enumerated in subdivision (g) of this note or meeting the requirements of subdivision (p) of this note (i) that are eligible for special tariff treatment under the United States-Mexico-Canada Agreement (USMCA), other than automobile knock-down kits or parts compilations; or (ii) that are not parts of passenger vehicles (sedans, sport utility vehicles, crossover utility vehicles, minivans, and cargo vans) and light trucks.

s232_usmca_mhd_parts_not_kits.label: Actual medium/heavy-duty vehicle parts eligible for USMCA, excluding knock-down kits and compilations
s232_usmca_mhd_parts_not_kits.description: Heading 9903.74.10 applies to all entries of articles classifiable under provisions of the HTSUS enumerated in subdivision (i) of this note or meeting the requirements of subdivision (j) of this note that qualify for preferential tariff treatment under the United States-Mexico-Canada Agreement (USMCA), other than medium- and heavy-duty vehicle knock-down kits or parts compilations.
